en: Dependent on a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement, a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement, a state that is not defiled but subject to defilement arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement, a state that is not defiled but subject to defilement... [arises by way of root-condition].
And not-defiled-non-prolific states arise by way of root condition … three.
Dependent on a not-defiled-prolific state, a not-defiled-prolific state arises by way of root condition … five.
Dependent on a not-defiled-non-prolific state, a defiled-prolific state arises … [by way of root condition].
Root condition. Dependent on a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement, there arises a state that is undefiled but subject to defilement by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement, there arise states that are both defiled and subject to defilement, and undefiled but subject to defilement, by way of root condition. ... Three [combinations]. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, there are eighteen; in the object condition, nine … pe … in the ripening condition, eleven … pe … in the non-disappearance condition, eighteen.
